svg.title: Duka Autopilot system architecture
svg.desc: Architecture showing messy customer inputs entering Cloud Run services, flowing through Pub/Sub into an ADK workflow on a private worker where deterministic code routes work, Gemini handles ambiguous content behind a deterministic tool boundary, and a refund gate suspends for a human decision; Firestore holds business truth and Vertex AI provides Gemini, resumable Sessions, and an advisory Memory Bank.
svg.text: GOOGLE CLOUD · ADK · GEMINI 3.7 FLASH — THE TASKMASTER
Duka Autopilot — the autonomous night shift
Autonomy where evidence is exact. Gemini where reality is messy. A human where consequences matter.
DUKA-WORKER · CLOUD RUN PUSH · PRIVATE — ADK WORKFLOW duka_autopilot
save_order · catalog prices win · scope from session, never from model args
deploy: GitHub Actions → WIF keyless → immutable digests · dev auto · prod manual gate
